verdict.rationale: The pack has no evidence that the Caveman project maintains its own test or eval suite to catch regressions in its skills. The closest item, "Your own requests become tests, and every change gets graded," describes a user-facing grading feature for customers' own requests, not regression testing of the collection's skills. The 24-prompt benchmark was run by an independent community member, not maintained by the project.

support.subject: As a developer, the collection maintains tests or evals for its skills so changes are verified against regressions rather than shipped on vibes
